description: Source of truth for /modus:init. Each entry is an opt-in config. category: plugin = enable via enabledPlugins; rule = one @import line in the project CLAUDE.md (synced by the core modus plugin); settings/mcp/environment/convention = merged or applied per the install steps. `scope` = where it lands (project | global | machine). `recommendWhen` lets /modus:init pre-check relevant items after sniffing the project.

entries.title: session-flow plugin (context guard + memory nudge + /roadmap over RFCs)
entries.summary: Context-budget guard (zero model tokens): a terminal warning for the user past ~90% of the window, one wrap-up request to the model when it is about to stop above that, and a re-arm plus hand-off check after each auto-compaction; a memory-review nudge after each git commit; and the /roadmap command over the project's <project>.rfcs specification repo — each RFC named NNNN-<slug>.md, where the number is a permanent ID that survives renames and the move into done/. Falls back to docs/roadmap/ for projects not migrated yet.
install: Merge {"enabledPlugins": {"session-flow@modus": true}} into <project>/.claude/settings.local.json (or settings.json to commit the choice).
Make sure the project has a <project>.rfcs repo (see the rfcs-repo entry); /roadmap falls back to docs/roadmap/ until it does.
Remove legacy copies if present: .claude/hooks/context-guard.mjs, .claude/commands/roadmap.md, and the matching hook entries in settings.local.json.
Restart the session so the plugin loads.
entries.recommendWhen: Project has a build + commit workflow and sessions get long.

entries.title: visual-iteration plugin (Playwright MCP + workflow skill)
entries.summary: Playwright MCP server plus the visual-iteration skill: serve scratch HTML/SVG over HTTP, iterate with element screenshots, clean up after.
install: Merge {"enabledPlugins": {"visual-iteration@modus": true}} into <project>/.claude/settings.local.json.
Remove a legacy playwright block from <project>/.mcp.json if the plugin now provides it.
Restart the session so the plugin loads.
entries.recommendWhen: Web / UI projects, or anything with visual output to iterate on.

entries.title: Session context wrap-up protocol (house rule)
entries.summary: Work in atomic build-passing units, checkpoint each, and hand off remaining scope to a docs/roadmap/ brief when the context window fills.
install: Ensure the core modus plugin is enabled at user scope (it syncs rules to ~/.claude/modus/rules/).
Add to the project CLAUDE.md under '## House rules': @~/.claude/modus/rules/session-wrap-up.md
If the rule body is pasted in CLAUDE.md from the pre-plugin era, replace the pasted section with the import line.
entries.recommendWhen: Paired with the session-flow plugin; any repo with long build sessions.

entries.title: Build (not just typecheck) before pushing (house rule)
entries.summary: Run the full build the deploy runs before committing/pushing.
install: Ensure the core modus plugin is enabled at user scope.
Add to the project CLAUDE.md under '## House rules': @~/.claude/modus/rules/build-before-push.md
entries.recommendWhen: Any project with a build/compile step that CI or the host runs.

entries.title: Direct-to-main push + auto-checkpoint (house rule)
entries.summary: Push straight to main and auto commit+push finished, build-passing units without being asked. Opt-in per repo.
install: ONLY for solo/trunk-based repos — confirm with the user first.
Ensure the core modus plugin is enabled at user scope.
Add to the project CLAUDE.md under '## House rules': @~/.claude/modus/rules/direct-push.md
entries.recommendWhen: Solo repos without PR review or protected branches. Confirm first.

entries.title: Specifications live in the project RFC repository (house rule)
entries.summary: Planning leaves the code repo. Every project that plans its work keeps it in a separate <project>.rfcs repository: numbered RFCs in rfcs/ (NNNN-<slug>.md with YAML frontmatter — title, authors, created, last_updated, status, status_note, label, depends, release), retired ones in rfcs/done/ keeping their number, the release registry in rfcs/releases.md, and standing reference (doctrine, design system, schema) at the repo root. Shape borrowed from openclaw/rfcs; the six-keyword status model, labels, depends and releases are ours. Replaces the pending-work-in-roadmap rule.
install: Ensure the core modus plugin is enabled at user scope (it syncs rules to ~/.claude/modus/rules/).
Add to the project CLAUDE.md under '## House rules': @~/.claude/modus/rules/rfc-convention.md
Add the same import line to the <project>.rfcs repo's CLAUDE.md, so both sides follow one rule.
If the repo still imports @~/.claude/modus/rules/pending-work-in-roadmap.md, replace that line — the rule was renamed, and the old path resolves to nothing.
Create the specs repo if it does not exist yet: see the rfcs-repo catalog entry.
entries.recommendWhen: Any repo keeping kickoff briefs in docs/roadmap/; pairs with session-flow's /roadmap and session-wrap-up's handoff step.

entries.title: No personal context in this repo (house rule)
entries.summary: A repo holds project information and project code, never information about the people who work on it: no names, ages or relationships (use roles), no real body/health/money/employment data (invent fixtures and mark them invented), no contact or location detail. State the shape a requirement has, not the instance. And it never names a personal knowledge base — no repo name, URL, org or path; tooling that must reach one reads ~/.claude/modus/personal-os and is inert when that file is absent.
install: Ensure the core modus plugin is enabled at user scope (it syncs rules to ~/.claude/modus/rules/).
Add to the project CLAUDE.md under '## House rules': @~/.claude/modus/rules/no-personal-context.md
State the rule in full alongside the import if the repo is or will be public — the import resolves to nothing for a reader without modus installed.

Audit what is already committed before relying on the rule: grep the repo and its git history for personal names, real measurements and any path into a personal knowledge base. The rule stops new leaks; it does not clean old ones.
If tooling in this repo routes findings outward, point it at ~/.claude/modus/personal-os and make the step silent when that file is missing.
entries.recommendWhen: Every repo. Non-negotiable for any repo that is public, will be public, or has collaborators.

entries.title: <project>.rfcs specification repository (layout + RFC template)
entries.summary: The repository that holds a project's plan: rfcs/0000-template.md to start an RFC, rfcs/done/ for retired ones, rfcs/releases.md for the release registry, and standing reference docs at the root. Cloned as a sibling of the code repo (Projects/tekio + Projects/tekio.rfcs) or inside the same workspace folder, which is also where the roadmap board looks for it.
install: gh repo create <owner>/<project>.rfcs --private, then clone it beside the code repo (or into the workspace folder).
mkdir -p rfcs/done and copy configs/rfcs/0000-template.md into rfcs/.
Write README.md (naming the code repo it plans) and CLAUDE.md (importing the rfc-convention rule) from the skeletons in configs/rfcs/README.md.
Migrating an existing docs/roadmap/? Move it with git filter-repo so the history comes too, then convert headers to frontmatter and pad IDs to four digits.
entries.recommendWhen: Project keeps a roadmap, task briefs, or design docs of any kind.

entries.title: Safe permission allowlist
entries.summary: Pre-allow low-risk, frequently-approved commands (e.g. `npm run *`) so the agent isn't prompted repeatedly.
install: Merge permissions.allow from configs/settings/permissions.json into <project>/.claude/settings.local.json.
Optionally run /fewer-permission-prompts later to grow the list from your own transcripts.
entries.recommendWhen: Node/npm projects. Adapt the globs for other stacks.

entries.title: Global agent settings (model / effort / notifications)
entries.summary: ~/.claude/settings.json preferences: model, effortLevel=xhigh, push notifications on background-agent completion.
install: Merge the keys from configs/settings/global-settings.json into ~/.claude/settings.json.
entries.recommendWhen: Set once per machine (global). Skip if already configured to taste.

entries.title: Supabase MCP server
entries.summary: Inspect/query a Supabase project (tables, migrations, logs, advisors) from the agent.
install: Add the supabase server block from configs/mcp/supabase.md to <project>/.mcp.json.
Provide a real sbp_ access token (never commit it — gitignore .mcp.json or inject from env).

entries.title: Git SSH push fix (Windows + Git Bash)
entries.summary: Point git at Windows-native ssh.exe globally, and keep the OpenSSH agent service running with the key loaded, so SSH pushes work from every shell in every repo.
install: Verify C:/WINDOWS/System32/OpenSSH/ssh.exe exists.
Run: git config --global core.sshCommand "C:/WINDOWS/System32/OpenSSH/ssh.exe"
Drop any stale per-repo override: git config --local --unset core.sshCommand
If pushes still hang: Set-Service ssh-agent -StartupType Automatic; Start-Service ssh-agent; ssh-add (type the key passphrase once).
entries.recommendWhen: Windows machine where SSH git pushes fail/hang. Set once per machine.

entries.title: Auto-memory protocol
entries.summary: File-based persistent memory kept outside the repo (~/.claude/projects/<slug>/memory/): one fact per file + a MEMORY.md index. Conventions for what to save and how.
install: This is a convention, not a copied file. Review configs/memory/README.md and follow it; the memory files are created on demand by the harness.
entries.recommendWhen: Any ongoing project where cross-session recall pays off.
